end.parentNote: Ishita practised drawing or describing how one term grows into the next, using rows, columns, and counting a shared corner once. They correctly used the added-row method in several examples. There was a mix-up between 19 and 20 dots, and Ishita corrected it later by recounting 9 + 9 + 1. At home, ask them to draw the first three figures of a pattern and explain which new row or corner is added each time.
